import json,urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
specs=[
 ('Bridge','chat-6ac45836-87a0-83ed-bea4-0ad0f99c8982'),
 ('Creator','chat-6ac455e9-bea0-83eb-aa94-fd3dde516c0c'),
 ('Growth','chat-6abf3eb2-40ec-83eb-9f7f-c4a32ad11fc0'),
 ('Native','agent-pc-control')
]
out=[]
for label,chat in specs:
 try:
  d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments?chatId='+chat,timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8'))
  rows=d.get('assignments',[])
  rows=sorted(rows,key=lambda x:str(x.get('createdAt') or x.get('updatedAt') or ''))
  keep=['id','branch','state','lastPreflightReason','lastDiagnostic','dispatchCount','dispatchSubmitAttempted','currentHead','ciRunId','ciConclusion','supervisorVerified','updatedAt','completedAt']
  out.append({'label':label,'rows':[{k:x.get(k) for k in keep} for x in rows[-4:]]})
 except Exception as e:
  out.append({'label':label,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
try:
 d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/api/projects/control-plane/operations',timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8'))
 out.append({'operations':[x for x in (d.get('operations') or []) if x.get('operationId')=='coord-20261007-native-r39-direct-01']})
except Exception as e:
 out.append({'operations_error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
